verbatim_agent_sentence: By issuing yen-denominated debt, we have effectively hedged our currency risk, allowing us to capture the attractive 4-5% dividend yields in an environment where Japanese government bond yields are near 0% [D04, D08].
grader_notes: The agent correctly identified the currency hedging strategy but failed to capture the primary motivations Buffett explicitly stated: long-term partnership and potential for mutual benefit in joint ventures. The agent instead prioritized valuation-based drivers (P/B ratios, yield) which were not cited as the core drivers in Buffett's official announcement. Sizing conviction was 'medium', whereas the actual was 'high'.
